title: Junta Airstrike Hits Byar La IDP Camp in Ponnagyun, Killing 12
detail: A Myanmar military airstrike hit the Byar La camp for displaced people in Ponnagyun Township, Rakhine State, on the evening of Friday Nov 13, 2026, killing 12 (including a five-year-old) and injuring 18, per a local rescue service cited by AFP. Witnesses said no jet was heard before the bombs fell and that the camp was not a combat area. Rakhine is mostly Arakan Army-controlled and under military blockade. The military did not comment.
